ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage and rPPG health monitoring platform built specifically to integrate with AWS managed AI services for fast rural healthcare assessment.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare Domain Use Case: AI-driven patient triage and remote health monitoring.
ideas.title: MediTriage AWS AI Clinical Gateway
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages AWS Student Community Day momentum and incorporates the proven architecture of mediscan-ai to deliver a working clinical frontend during the 2-day hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An automated AML risk detection and investigation platform combining graph intelligence and gradient boosting for instant BFSI transaction auditing.
ideas.problem_statement: BFSI Domain Use Case: Real-time anti-money laundering and risk detection in banking transactions.
ideas.title: GraphGuard AML: AWS Financial Fraud Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the technical stack and rigorous graph-based approach of Bito, which won 1st place in a major financial AI hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent retail inventory assistant that forecasts stock trends using calibrated probabilistic models and local store data.
ideas.problem_statement: Retail Domain Use Case: Intelligent supply chain and automated demand forecasting.
ideas.title: RetailGraph Inventory & Demand Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes statistically robust prediction intervals inspired by apart research winners, appealing strongly to judges looking for mathematical rigor rather than simple wrappers.

ideas.pitch: A secure, low-latency voice assistant utilizing RAG to help patients navigate hospital policies and retrieve clinical records in regional languages.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare Domain Use Case: Multilingual patient query resolution and hospital navigation.
ideas.title: CareAgent Voice: Multilingual Hospital RAG
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard voice-to-text accuracy and localized retrieval, mirroring the exact winning mechanics of Voz-AI.

ideas.pitch: An automated insurance claim risk analyzer that forecasts payout anomalies and flags fraudulent claims using Poisson regression models.
ideas.problem_statement: BFSI Domain Use Case: Automated insurance claim risk modeling and anomaly detection.
ideas.title: InsurGuard AI Incident & Claim Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous probabilistic forecasting that stands out among standard LLM wrapper projects in financial tracks.
